purpose: Diagnostic only; no gameplay state is modified. Counterbalance choice order and add redundant relative-edge facts derived only from the same visible observation.

state.previousResult: Find the exit. Seven entries per room.

action.instructions: Explore the maze and escape through an observed exit. Choose one action. Edges and memory use N,E,S,W: # wall, . passage, E exit, ? unseen. Memory rows are [room, visits, edges, entriesLeft]. Avoid walls and repeated rooms. Room numbers are row-major; north decreases the row. You cannot move backwards. A turn changes only orientation; FORWARD goes in the facing direction. Entering the same room seven times loses. Use explored memory to navigate; an exit requires moving FORWARD through it.

criteria.FORWARD: Move one room in the current facing direction, or cross an exit ahead.
criteria.TURN_LEFT: Rotate 90 degrees left; stay in the same room.
criteria.TURN_RIGHT: Rotate 90 degrees right; stay in the same room.
